posts.author: Kedoi2
posts.title: NON-VIOLENT players forum.
posts.html:
I believe the main reason for killing, raids and such is because there is no alternative to that besides making money to buy what? guns.

We need a plethora of new non-violent ideas and jobs to incorporate into the new server as our first step to stopping DM and revolutionizing the server for the better. making the guns more expensive helps yes, but when there is little to do but kill people will find a way. please post ANY ideas toward this cause.

and if the admins like this idea we can keep this thread running for awhile and get lotsa ideas flowing.

Here are a few off the top of my head.

1. More food types: Whenever im a chef and make a cool looking farmers market, all i can sell is chinese takeout and beans. exciting. I would like more variety like bananas, oranges, melons, and custom food models too would help. For a creative player like me this would be a blast.

1 1/2 : Instead of ordering shipments of the food you would buy shipments of ingredients and use a stove and such to cook up the food. (the CSS food pile model might come in handy) like crates of certain ingredients, or shipments of many. For me this would be very fun.

2. Diseases: Random or Contagious! this would give doctors more of a purpose because most people die or sleep to heal themselves. These diseases would not go away unless you were A. killed by it. or B. Cured... They could have effects like blurred/bloomed/loss of vision, low stamina, low health, low speed, talking time limits and so on. Some new drugs would have to be coded in like painkillers for temporary satisfaction. Also gunshot wounds must be attended to, or led poisoning and such.

3. PCs: I saw these might be incorporated from Lexi's whiteboard (XD) so we could have techs that repair them and sell the parts and programs.

4. Cabbies: A custom Cab model and car would have to be coded in, but a fast cheap service to get around evocity might come in handy.

5. Fun stuffs: Hats? maybe funny weapons like rubber hammers n shit that are humorous but not dangerous. Someone who makes a business in this would be quite popular.

thats all i have for now. please post on here!!! any ideas help even if you get a big fat NO from Lexi. (that happens alot) (XD)
